validationScope: Runtime: all 19 landmark IDs, labels, building types, footprints, doors, interior aliases, counts, city dimensions and spawn. Whole-file SHA-256 parity is verified by build tests, not computed by this runtime module.
namespacePolicy: Strict methods distinguish stable place IDs, legacy building IDs, legacy interior keys, scene IDs, approach IDs and enterable door IDs. Unknown or wrong-namespace values return null.
geometryPolicy: No source object, route, collision, actor, case, room, render or storage mutation. No Atlas schematic coordinates are used; no crossing identities are remapped.
